age.evidence: Male Swiss-Webster mice were obtained from Harlan ... at approximately 8 weeks of age and tested at approximately 10 weeks of age.

sex.evidence: Male Sprague-Dawley rats ... Male Swiss-Webster mice ...

psychedelic: 2C-C, 2C-D, 2C-E, 2C-I, 2C-T-2, DOC (with DMT, DOM, LSD, MDMA, METH as discrimination training drugs)

dosing.evidence: Separate groups of eight mice were injected intraperitoneally with either vehicle (0.9 % saline), 2C-C (1, 3, 10, 30, and 100 mg/kg) ... immediately prior to locomotor activity testing.
Separate groups of eight mice were injected intraperitoneally with ... 2C-D (1, 3, 10, and 30 mg/kg) ...
Separate groups of eight mice were injected intraperitoneally with ... 2C-E (0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, 10, and 30 mg/kg) ...
Separate groups of eight mice were injected intraperitoneally with ... 2C-I (0.3, 1, 3, 10, and 30 mg/kg) ...
Separate groups of eight mice were injected intraperitoneally with ... 2C-T-2 (0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, and 10 mg/kg) ...
Separate groups of eight mice were injected intraperitoneally with ... DOC (0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, and 10 mg/kg) ...
separate groups comprising 15 to 32 rats were trained to discriminate one of the five compounds from saline: METH (1 mg/kg), MDMA (1.5 mg/kg), LSD (0.1 mg/kg), DOM (0.5 mg/kg), and DMT (5 mg/kg)
DMT (5 mg/kg) ... Pretreatment times were 5 min for DMT
MDMA (1.5 mg/kg) ... 15 min for LSD and MDMA

handling.evidence: No handling protocol described in methods.

group_housing.evidence: All the rats were housed individually ... The mice were group-housed in cages — rats (subjects of the drug-discrimination assay) were single-housed.

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained on a 12:12 light/dark cycle (lights on at 7:00 A.M.) ... beginning at 0800 (2 h after lights on).

enrichment_housing.evidence: No mention of home-cage enrichment items.

assays.assay_description: Digiscan locomotor chambers (40.5×40.5×30.5 cm). Mice injected i.p. with vehicle or one of six phenethylamines (various doses) and immediately placed in chamber. Horizontal photobeam interruptions recorded in 10-min bins for 8 h.

application_type.evidence: injected intraperitoneally with either vehicle (0.9 % saline) ... immediately prior to locomotor activity testing.

setup_habituation.evidence: No apparatus habituation described; mice were injected immediately prior to testing.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice moved freely within the Digiscan locomotor chambers.

food_restriction.evidence: Mice had ad libitum food in home cage; testing apparatus is a standard activity chamber without food.

water_restriction.evidence: Mice had free access to water in home cage; no water in testing apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: injected ... immediately prior to locomotor activity testing.

sample_size.evidence: Separate groups of eight mice were injected intraperitoneally ... N=8 for each treatment.

outcomes.summary: All six phenethylamines depressed mouse locomotor activity at higher doses, with effects emerging within 10–20 min and lasting 30–120 min. 2C-D (3 mg/kg) and 2C-E (0.3–1 mg/kg) produced delayed stimulation of locomotor activity at low doses. 100 mg/kg 2C-C caused convulsions/tremors/lethality, and 100 mg/kg 2C-D was lethal in all mice.
outcomes.evidence: The phenethylamines depressed mouse locomotor activity, although 2C-D and 2C-E stimulated activity at low doses.

B1_num_measures.evidence: horizontal activity (interruption of photocell beams) was measured

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: measured for 8 h within 10-min periods ... Figure 2 shows the time course data

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analysis reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Only photocell beam-break locomotor counts quantified.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Spontaneous locomotor test; no learning required.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Digiscan (Omnitech Electronics) photocell beam-break system — position/activity tracking only.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Digiscan (model RXYZCM, Omnitech Electronics) locomotor activity testing chambers (40.5×40.5×30.5 cm).

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding mentioned in testing apparatus.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in testing apparatus.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in testing chamber.

D1_continuity.evidence: horizontal activity was measured for 8 h within 10-min periods

D3_recording_days.evidence: Single session per mouse beginning at 0800; no second day of locomotor recording described.

D4_baseline.evidence: Drug injected immediately prior to testing; no pre-drug recording reported.

D5_followup.evidence: No follow-up locomotor session ≥24 h after dosing.

assays.assay_description: Coulbourn operant chambers with two levers under FR10 schedule of food reinforcement. Rats previously trained to discriminate one of five drugs (DMT, DOM, LSD, MDMA, METH) from saline. Test substitution sessions (≤20 min) with 2C-C, 2C-D, 2C-E, 2C-I, 2C-T-2, or DOC given i.p. (15 min pretreatment, plus 60/70 min for DOC/2C-D). Outcomes: % drug-appropriate responding and response rate.

application_type.evidence: rats were injected i.p. with either saline or drug and then placed in the operant chambers

setup_habituation.evidence: No separate apparatus habituation described beyond extensive training.

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats freely moved within the operant chamber while pressing levers.

food_restriction.evidence: Body weights were maintained at 320-350 g by limiting food to 15 g/day which included the food received during operant sessions.

water_restriction.evidence: Water was freely available [in home cage]; no water source in operant chamber.

time_to_assay.evidence: All the compounds were tested 15 min after i.p. injection ... DOC and 2C-D were also tested 60 and 70 min, respectively, after injection.

sample_size.evidence: 2C-C, 2C-D, 2C-E, 2C-I, 2C-T-2, or DOC were tested for substitution in subsets of six rats from each training drug group.

outcomes.summary: Five of six phenethylamines fully substituted for at least one hallucinogenic training drug (DMT, DOM, and/or LSD); none fully substituted for METH. 2C-T-2 only partially substituted for DMT. 2C-C and 2C-E fully substituted for MDMA; others produced partial or no MDMA substitution. Higher doses suppressed response rates across training drug groups.
outcomes.evidence: The phenethylamines except 2C-T-2 fully substituted for at least one hallucinogenic training compound, but none fully substituted for (+)-methamphetamine.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Data were collected as the mean percentage of training-drug-appropriate responses ... The response rates were expressed as the number of responses made, divided by the total session time.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Single session totals reported, no within-session time-course analysis.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analysis reported.

B5_social.evidence: Rats tested individually in operant chambers.

B6_cognitive.evidence: rats were trained to discriminate one of the five compounds from saline — requires learned discrimination.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: MED-PC IV / Med Associates — operant lever-press recording, not behavioural classification.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Univariate ANOVAs and ED50 linear fits only.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in operant chamber.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in operant chamber.

E6_spatial.evidence: Single operant chamber compartment with two levers.

E8_food_water.evidence: food (45 mg of food pellets; Bio-Serve) was available under a fixed-ratio 10 schedule of reinforcement

D1_continuity.evidence: Doses of these compounds were presented incrementally in separate sessions, using a repeated measures design ... also tested 60 and 70 min, respectively, after injection.

D2_session_duration.evidence: The substitution test sessions lasted for a maximum of 20 min.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Doses of these compounds were presented incrementally in separate sessions ... repeated measures design (each rat tested at all doses).

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug baseline test session reported as data for substitution assay.

D5_followup.evidence: Substitution tests done acutely; no ≥24 h post-drug recording.

judge_notes: Two behavioural assays included: (1) mouse locomotor activity in Digiscan chambers, (2) rat drug-discrimination two-lever operant task. All in vitro receptor/transporter binding and functional assays excluded per rubric.

Group_housing scored 'no' because experimental subjects of the drug-discrimination assay (rats) were explicitly housed individually; mice were group-housed. Chose 'no' as the rat subjects represent the assay with longer protocol; documented both in evidence.

Food_restriction differs between assays: rats in drug discrimination were maintained on a 15 g/day food limit (scored 'before'); mice in locomotor were ad libitum (no restriction; scored 'during' since no food in apparatus).
D1 for locomotor scored 'Continuous monitoring' (2) given uninterrupted 8 h recording matches the rubric definition of continuous (≥6 h).
DOC and 2C-D drug-discrimination tests at 15 min and 60/70 min are the same assay tested at two timepoints (one assay, not two).
